title: Dynamics of the Longest-Edge Altitude Bisection Algorithm
summary: We study a longest-edge based refinement scheme for triangulations, termed the longest-edge altitude bisection (LEAB), in which each triangle is subdivided by dropping the altitude from the vertex opposite to its longest edge. Using the normalized shape space of triangles introduced by Perdomo and Plaza in: Properties of triangulations obtained by the longest-edge bisection. \emph{Cent. Eur. J.
